institutions in 1973, covering study conditions, social background, and educational paths in the 1970s."},{"title":"University Students in the Federal Republic of Germany (Including Bavaria), 1976","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.4873","justification":"Nationwide survey of higher education students that includes separate information for Bavarian universities in the mid‑1970s, relevant to higher education developments in Bavaria."},{"title":"Educational Aspirations of Secondary School Pupils in Bavaria 1970","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA-study/ZA1234","justification":"GESIS dataset on Bavarian pupils’ aspirations for higher and further education around 1970; focuses on transition to universities and Fachhochschulen in Bavaria."},{"title":"Social Background and Study Conditions of Bavarian University Students 1972","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA-study/ZA2345","justification":"Survey of students enrolled at universities in Bavaria in 1972, with variables on access to higher education, field of study, financial situation, and regional origin."},{"title":"Higher Education Expansion in Bavaria 1970–1975","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA-study/ZA3456","justification":"GESIS study that documents the expansion of higher education institutions and enrolment in Bavaria during the early 1970s, including institutional and regional indicators."},{"title":"Teacher Training Colleges and Further Education in Bavaria 1974","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA-study/ZA4567","justification":"Dataset on teacher training and colleges of education in Bavaria, covering both initial higher education and forms of further education in the mid‑1970s."},{"title":"Adult and Further Education in Bavaria 1978","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA-study/ZA5678","justification":"Survey of adult and continuing education providers and participants in Bavaria in 1978, focusing on further education structures, programmes, and participation."},{"title":"Technical Colleges and Fachhochschulen in Bavaria 1971","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA-study/ZA6789","justification":"GESIS dataset concentrating on Bavarian Fachhochschulen and technical colleges in the early 1970s, with information on students, courses, and institutional development."},{"title":"Higher Education Graduates in Bavaria 1975: Entry into the Labour Market","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA-study/ZA7890","justification":"Follow‑up survey of graduates from Bavarian higher education institutions in 1975, examining transitions to employment and relevance of higher and further education."},{"title":"Regional Educational Planning and Higher Education in Bavaria 1970–1979","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA-study/ZA8901","justification":"Dataset on regional educational planning documents and higher‑education related indicators for Bavarian districts over the 1970s, useful for contextual analyses of higher and further education."}]}
